findings.description: Typed memberships and primitive decidability/single-occupant flags are not complete K/C/R/N payload semantics, an implemented general decider, path algebra or proof of schema-language expressiveness. A bounded inspection profile is a separate candidate.
findings.owner_route: role:definition-owner and schema/profile owners must select content language, total decidable inspections and operator boundaries.

findings.description: Local occupant constraints C and connection rules N are separate dimensions. Four finite controls and empty-C/empty-N examples do not prove complete canonical independence or nonreduction across arbitrary schemas.
findings.owner_route: role:definition-owner and D29 owner must review common carriers, variation denominators and independence obligations.

findings.description: Relative schema use and upper-level occupancy share Entity to permit dual roles. LevelBelow, strict hierarchy and role-use contexts require reviewed mappings; kind-at-one-level is not automatic semantic identity or type collapse.
findings.owner_route: role:definition-owner and level/metamodel owners must review governed versus representation levels, allowed role contrasts and hierarchy semantics.

findings.description: Shape conformance entails assigned ShapeEvidence only in the candidate slice; truth, ownership, authority, promotion and execution proof remain separate targets. An actually valid implementation/result needs exact evaluator and source bindings.
findings.owner_route: role:definition-owner, authority and contract owners must confirm evidence semantics, non-entailment and actual outcome contracts.

findings.description: Schema content is distinct from schema amendment witnessing. Comparing finite acceptance examples does not prove universal migration compatibility, semantic preservation, source-owner approval or authority to mutate a schema.
findings.owner_route: role:definition-owner and Schema Evolution Invariant owner must select revision/migration obligations and exact acceptance denominator.
